videos.script: A large customer asks the shop for its ISO 27001 certificate. What exactly is it asking for? {{asks}} Not a product, and not a list of controls. ISO 27001 certifies a management system: the way an organisation decides what to protect, does it, checks it, and improves. {{system}} Its sister standard, 27002, is the catalogue of controls: ninety-three of them in four themes. {{catalogue}} Between the two sits one document that ties them to a real company: the statement of applicability. It says which controls apply, why, and how far along each one is. {{soa}} At the end of the lesson you will know what an auditor checks, in what order, and why a certificate lasts three years and still gets visited every year. {{audit}}
